text:
Amanda Li: @here Quick heads-up — Hosted Edge MiniGateway is GA as of today (rolling from 09:00 PT). This is a lightweight regional gateway for low-latency hosted inference (APAC / EU first). Rollout schedule below, docs & runbook links in thread. Pls scan if you're oncall or working on SDKs/ops.

Raj Patel: Nice! Does this alter default model routing or require customer changes?

Amanda Li: Good q. Default routing will prefer nearest MiniGateway region. Customers can force region with X-Region header or query param. No model changes required unless they want a specific region pin.

Amanda Li: Quick curl example:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" 
     -H "X-Region: ap-sg" 
     -d '{"model":"mosaic-lite","input":"Summarize this..."}' 
     https://api.redwood.ai/v2/edge/generate
```

OpsBot: deploy: canary ap-sg 3% -> 15% succeeded (1987654480) :rocket:

Sara Nguyen: Will this impact billing for hosted API users?

Amanda Li: Short answer: small per-token surcharge on MiniGateway routes to cover pre-warmed pools + local infra. Net cost often lower due to reduced egress. Full pricing note: https://redwood.internal/pricing/edge-minigw (internal).

Chris Morales: Any SLA changes or new support paths?

Amanda Li: SLA remains the same for paid hosted plans. For MiniGateway-specific incidents we have a dedicated runbook and pager rotation (link in docs). Dedicated & Private customers unaffected.

DevEx Bot: SDK update: edge client added in redwood-js@0.9.3 and redwood-py@0.9.3. Example (node):
```js
import { EdgeClient } from '@redwood/inference';
const c = new EdgeClient({ region: 'eu-fr' });
await c.generate({ model: 'mosaic-lite', prompt: '...' });
```

Ben Ortiz: Who's the point for rollbacks if we see regressions during ramp?

Amanda Li: Ops lead is @Chris Morales. Rollback triggers: sustained error rate > 3% over 5m, latency p95 > 2x baseline, or customer complaints flagged by CSMs. Rollback path: feature-flag F_edge_minigw -> instant fallback to standard hosted endpoints for affected regions.

Raj Patel: How are we doing observability? Dashboards?

Amanda Li: Telemetry: per-region token counts, model mix, p50/p95 latency, cold-start ratio, and cache hit rate. Dashboards: Console -> Observability -> Edge Gateway. Alerts: edge-high-error, edge-high-latency (paged).

DeployBot: rollout: regional -> ap-sg, eu-fr, us-west; canary progression scheduled next 48h (1987654600).

Sara Nguyen: Customer comms — are we emailing customers or auto-migrating?

Amanda Li: Auto-migrate for self-serve customers unless they opt-out. Enterprise CSMs will send a tailored note and offer testing windows. Marketing/Comms draft: internal link to draft comms.

Ben Ortiz: Anything for security/compliance teams?

Amanda Li: MiniGateway supports KMS for keys and retains same audit logs. Private deployment customers can opt out; MiniGateway won't be enabled by default for regulated customers. Security doc in repo.

Chris Morales: +1 to runbook additions. I added a quick checklist for oncall in the ops playbook.

Amanda Li: Thx all — major ask: if you own an SDK, CLI, or customer-facing integration, please verify the new endpoint & header behavior by EOD tomorrow. Ping me for any blockers. :thumbsup:

Raj Patel: Will do.

Ben Ortiz: Pinged CSMs to prep comms.

OpsBot: note: incident channel #eng-oncall mirrored for edge-high-error alerts.

Amanda Li: Closing with links: docs: https://redwood.internal/docs/edge-minigateway-ga, runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/edge-minigw, pricing: https://redwood.internal/pricing/edge-minigw. If you need a test key for staging reach out to me or @Ben Ortiz.
